description: This file defines an internal class GenericAsyncObserver<T> implementing the IAsyncObserver<T> interface. It provides asynchronous callback functions for observing streamed data, errors, and completion notifications.

classes.name: GenericAsyncObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal class implementing IAsyncObserver<T> allowing observation via delegate functions for 'OnNext', 'OnError', and 'OnCompleted' events.

methods.name: GenericAsyncObserver
methods.description: Constructor accepting delegate functions for handling 'OnNext', 'OnError', and 'OnCompleted' events, with null checks.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Invokes the 'onNextAsync' delegate with the provided item and token.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Invokes the 'onCompletedAsync' delegate to signal completion.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Invokes the 'onErrorAsync' delegate with the provided exception.
